# RHA Lodges (Islamabad, G-13)

> Premium hospitality, uncompromised security, and ethical family lodging in Islamabad.

RHA Lodges is a premier boutique guest house and lodging brand located in G-13/1, Islamabad. It caters specifically to families, corporate executives, and diplomat staffers seeking a pristine, secure, and peaceful stay near key transit points and local business centers.

## Core Metadata
- **Official Website:** <https://www.rhalodges.com>
- **Business Type:** Guest House / Boutique Lodges
- **Physical Address:** House 58, Street 101, Sector G-13/1, Islamabad, Pakistan
- **Location Advantage:** Situated right near Srinagar Highway, 15 minutes from Islamabad International Airport (ISB).
- **Guest Standard:** Exclusively reserved for families, corporate executives, and diplomatic personnel.

## Accommodation Options
- **The Executive Suite (Master Bed):** Spacious master bedroom featuring a king-size bed, luxurious sitting lounge area, premium furnishing, high-definition television, and full climate control.
- **Premium Deluxe Room (Attached Bath):** Exquisitely furnished ensuite bedroom featuring a master bed, dedicated writing/study corner, large wardrobe, modern attached washroom, and direct natural light.
- **Comfortable Family Stay Suite:** Multi-bed spacious suite configurability optimized for families traveling together, offering joint privacy, extra bedding, and complete home comforts.

## Key Amenities & Services
- **Comp Breakfast:** Freshly prepared hot Pakistani breakfast (flaky parathas, customized omelettes, and warm Karak tea) or Continental options served daily in the cozy dining lounge.
- **Safety & Security:** Dual-gate security access framework, 24/7 on-site physical guards, CCTV monitoring, and strict guest vetting protocols for absolute mental peace.
- **Free Gated Parking:** Completely free, enclosed on-site courtyard parking accommodating guest vehicles securely.
- **Fiber WiFi:** Enterprise-grade ultra-fast fiber optic internet connection with robust coverage across all hallways, lounge suites, and exterior seating areas.
- **Bespoke Hospitality:** 24/7 guest reception desk, daily housekeeping, hot water, continuous backup power generators, and iron/laundry services upon request.

## Booking and Reservations
- **Direct WhatsApp Channel:** Customers can connect directly at the 24/7 booking desk for instant availability quotes, personalized room setups, and booking confirmations.
- **Contact Page:** A dynamic inquiry widget is also available on the website main contact portal relative to custom corporate bookings or longer-term stay queries.
- **Ethical Vetting Policy:** To maintain a peaceful environment, all reservations are subjected to strict ID vetting. No loud parties, commercial events, or unauthorized gatherings are permitted on-site.
